notes.title: WIP Feature - Green Laning
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ksnxv1UToF0;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey all,

Here's a preview of one of the Steam-exclusive features I've been working on: off-road trails, reminiscent of "green lanes" found deep in rural England. It's a simple effect, but really alters the feel of the game into something more remote and still. This came about as an experiment for a future off-road location - more details on that soon...

Anslo
